@@ -0,0 +1,233 @@
1+;; tools/native-inventory.lg — every native var a stock lg exposes, with where
2+;; let-go registers it. The var list is runtime truth (every public var in every
3+;; loaded ns whose value is a NativeFn); the Go sources only supply file:line,
4+;; arity and the registration style, read at the binary's own SHA via
5+;; `git show`, so a let-go checkout that has moved on cannot skew the mapping.
6+;;
7+;; lg tools/native-inventory.lg [let-go-dir] [sha]
8+;;
9+;; TSV columns: var arities source registered-via match same-fn-as
10+;; arities: "N" fixed, ">=N" variadic, "?" when the Go side checks arity at
11+;; run time (the vm.NativeFnType.Wrap proxy style hides it)
12+;; registered-via: lg:native | ns.Def | other
13+;; match: exact (ns+name agree) | name (Def in a ns the scanner could not name
14+;; statically, e.g. installMathInto(nsName)) | none
15+(require '[clojure.string :as str])
16+
17+(def argv (vec (rest (drop-while #(not (str/ends-with? % "native-inventory.lg")) os/args))))
18+(def letgo (get argv 0 (str (os/getenv "HOME") "/projects-new/3p/let-go")))
19+
20+(defn sh-out [& cmd]
21+ (let [r (apply os/sh cmd)]
22+ (when-not (zero? (:exit r)) (throw (ex-info (str "failed: " (str/join " " cmd) "\n" (:err r)) {})))
23+ (:out r)))
24+
25+;; The SHA the running binary was built from: `lg -version` prints "(4e76921)".
26+(def sha
27+ (or (get argv 1)
28+ (second (re-find #"\(([0-9a-f]{7,40})\)" (sh-out (first os/args) "-version")))
29+ (throw (ex-info "cannot determine lg's let-go SHA; pass it" {}))))
30+(def full-sha (str/trim (sh-out "git" "-C" letgo "rev-parse" sha)))
31+(def commit-date (str/trim (sh-out "git" "-C" letgo "show" "-s" "--format=%cs" sha)))
32+
33+(def ns-alias-map {"clojure.core" "core" "clojure.test" "test" "clojure.string" "string"
34+ "clojure.set" "set" "clojure.walk" "walk" "clojure.edn" "edn"
35+ "clojure.zip" "zip" "clojure.data" "data" "clojure.test.tap" "test.tap"})
36+(defn canon-ns [n] (get ns-alias-map n n))
37+
38+(defn grep-files [& pats]
39+ (let [args (concat ["git" "-C" letgo "grep" "-l" "-E"] (mapcat (fn [p] ["-e" p]) pats)
40+ [sha "--" "pkg/*.go" ":!*_test.go"])
41+ r (apply os/sh args)]
42+ ;; git grep prints "<sha>:<path>"
43+ (map #(subs % (inc (str/index-of % ":"))) (remove str/blank? (str/split-lines (:out r))))))
44+
45+(def file-lines
46+ (memoize (fn [path] (vec (str/split-lines (sh-out "git" "-C" letgo "show" (str sha ":" path)))))))
47+
48+(defn kebab [ident]
49+ ;; primgen's KebabCase for the default lg name: CamelCase → camel-case
50+ (str/lower-case (str/replace ident #"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])" "$1-$2")))
51+
52+(defn split-params [s]
53+ ;; top-level commas only: a func-typed param carries its own parens
54+ (loop [cs (seq s) depth 0 cur "" out []]
55+ (if-let [c (first cs)]
56+ (cond (#{\( \[ \{} c) (recur (rest cs) (inc depth) (str cur c) out)
57+ (#{\) \] \}} c) (recur (rest cs) (dec depth) (str cur c) out)
58+ (and (= c \,) (zero? depth)) (recur (rest cs) depth "" (conj out (str/trim cur)))
59+ :else (recur (rest cs) depth (str cur c) out))
60+ (remove str/blank? (conj out (str/trim cur))))))
61+
62+(defn sig-arity [func-line]
63+ ;; "func Ident(params) ..." → "N" | ">=N" | "?" (signature continues on the next line)
64+ (if-let [[_ ps] (re-find #"^func \w+\((.*?)\)\s*[\(\w\{*\[]" func-line)]
65+ (let [items (split-params ps)
66+ items (if (and (seq items) (re-find #"\*vm\.ExecContext" (first items))) (rest items) items)
67+ n (count items)]
68+ (if (and (pos? n) (str/includes? (last items) "...")) (str ">=" (dec n)) (str n)))
69+ "?"))
70+
71+;; ---- //lg:native directives (what cmd/lgprimgen consumes) ----
72+(defn scan-directives [path]
73+ (let [ls (file-lines path)]
74+ (for [i (range (count ls)) :when (= "//lg:native" (str/trim (ls i)))]
75+ (let [tail (take-while #(not (str/starts-with? % "func ")) (subvec ls (inc i) (min (count ls) (+ i 30))))
76+ fl (get ls (+ i 1 (count tail)) "")
77+ dir (fn [k] (some #(second (re-find (re-pattern (str "^//lg:" k " (.+)$")) (str/trim %))) tail))
78+ ident (second (re-find #"^func (\w+)" fl))]
79+ {:ns (canon-ns (or (dir "ns") "clojure.core"))
80+ :name (or (dir "name") (kebab (or ident "?")))
81+ :line (+ i 2 (count tail)) :path path :via "lg:native" :arity (sig-arity fl)
82+ ;; outside pkg/rt proper (corefns) the generated registrar only records
83+ ;; a direct-call descriptor (RegisterNativeModule); the var itself is
84+ ;; Def'd elsewhere, so such a directive is a fallback source only
85+ :weak (not (re-find #"^pkg/rt/[^/]+\.go$" path))}))))
86+
87+;; ---- Go registration sites other than the directive ----
88+;; ns.Def("name", v): the ns comes from the receiver when it was bound to a
89+;; literal namespace in the same func (`ns := vm.NewNamespace("os")`,
90+;; `longNS := DefNSBare("Long")`); nil when it is computed (installMathInto).
91+;; LookupOrAdd(vm.Symbol("name")) and New*NativeFn("name", …) / wrapNNamed("name", …)
92+;; are the registrations that bypass Def (compiler/eval.go, gogen's entry table).
93+(def ns-ctor #"(\w+)\s*:?=\s*(?:vm\.NewNamespace|DefNSBare|DefNS|LookupOrRegisterNS)\((?:\"([^\"]+)\"|(\w+))\)")
94+
95+;; `const NameCoreNS = "core"` — lang.go builds core from the constant
96+(def ns-consts
97+ (let [r (os/sh "git" "-C" letgo "grep" "-h" "-E" "-e" "Name\\w*NS\\s*=\\s*\"" sha "--" "pkg/rt/*.go")]
98+ (into {} (for [[_ k v] (re-seq #"(Name\w*NS)\s*=\s*\"([^\"]+)\"" (:out r))] [k (canon-ns v)]))))
99+
100+(defn hint-arity [l]
101+ ;; arity readable off the wrapper at the site; "?" for the []vm.Value proxies
102+ (if-let [[_ n v] (re-find #"NewArityNativeFn\(\"[^\"]*\",\s*(\d+),\s*(true|false)" l)]
103+ (if (= v "true") (str ">=" n) n)
104+ (or (second (re-find #"\b(?:mathFn|wrap)(\d)(?:Named)?\(" l)) "?")))
105+
106+(defn scan-defs [path]
107+ (let [ls (file-lines path)]
108+ (loop [i 0 recv {} out []]
109+ (if (>= i (count ls))
110+ out
111+ (let [l (ls i)
112+ recv (if (str/starts-with? l "func ") {} recv)
113+ recv (reduce (fn [m [_ r lit k]] (assoc m r (if lit (canon-ns lit) (ns-consts k)))) recv (re-seq ns-ctor l))
114+ site (fn [ns nm via] {:ns ns :name nm :line (inc i) :path path :via via :arity (hint-arity l)})
115+ out (-> out
116+ ;; recv.Def("x" …) or defStaticNS("Array").Def("x" …)
117+ (into (for [[_ r lit nm] (re-seq #"(?:(\w+)|\w+\((?:\"([^\"]+)\"|\w+)\))\.Def\(\"([^\"]+)\"" l)]
118+ (site (if lit (canon-ns lit) (recv r)) nm "ns.Def")))
119+ (into (for [[_ nm] (re-seq #"LookupOrAdd\(vm\.Symbol\(\"([^\"]+)\"\)\)" l)]
120+ (site nil nm "other")))
121+ (into (for [[_ nm] (re-seq #"(?:New\w*NativeFn|wrap\dNamed|mk|makeVariadic)\(\"([^\"]+)\"" l)]
122+ (assoc (site nil nm "other") :weak true))))]
123+ (recur (inc i) recv out))))))
124+
125+;; Constructors registered under computed names (exceptions.go's `"->" + bare`
126+;; loop, host_stringbuilder's spellings): the Def call takes a variable.
127+(defn scan-computed [path]
128+ (let [ls (file-lines path)]
129+ (for [i (range (count ls)) :when (re-find #"\.Def\((spelling|\w*[Nn]ame|n|s)\b" (ls i))]
130+ {:path path :line (inc i) :text (str/join "\n" ls)})))
131+
132+;; (def alias native) in the embedded lg sources: `(def ref atom)`, hash.lg's
133+;; `(def xxh3-64 xxh3/Hash)`. The ns is the file's own (ns …) form.
134+(defn scan-lg-defs [path]
135+ (let [ls (file-lines path)
136+ ns (some #(some-> (second (re-find #"^\(ns\s+([^\s()]+)" %)) canon-ns) ls)]
137+ (for [i (range (count ls))
138+ :let [[_ nm] (re-find #"^\(def\s+(?:\^\S+\s+)?([^\s()\[\]]+)\s" (ls i))]
139+ :when (and nm ns)]
140+ {:ns ns :name nm :line (inc i) :path path :via "other" :arity "?"})))
141+
142+(defn grep-lg-files [pat]
143+ (let [r (os/sh "git" "-C" letgo "grep" "-l" "-E" "-e" pat sha "--" "pkg/rt/core/*.lg")]
144+ (map #(subs % (inc (str/index-of % ":"))) (remove str/blank? (str/split-lines (:out r))))))
145+
146+(def def-files (grep-files "\\.Def\\(" "LookupOrAdd\\(vm\\.Symbol" "NativeFn\\(\"" "wrap[0-9]Named\\(\"" "mk\\(\""))
147+(def sites (concat (mapcat scan-directives (grep-files "^//lg:native"))
148+ (mapcat scan-defs def-files)
149+ (mapcat scan-lg-defs (grep-lg-files "^\\(def "))))
150+(def computed (mapcat scan-computed def-files))
151+
152+(defn rank [{:keys [path via weak]}]
153+ ;; pkg/rt proper beats sub-packages (corefns mirrors), unconstrained files beat
154+ ;; per-target ones (syscall_linux, term_wasm …), the directive beats a Def,
155+ ;; a registration beats a bare constructor name
156+ [(if (re-find #"_(linux|plan9|wasm|js|tinygo|windows|wasip1)\.go$" path) 1 0)
157+ (if weak 1 0)
158+ (if (re-find #"^pkg/rt/[^/]+\.go$" path) 0 1)
159+ (if (= via "lg:native") 0 1)
160+ path])
161+
162+(def by-ns+name (group-by (juxt :ns :name) (filter :ns sites)))
163+(def by-name (group-by :name (remove :ns sites)))
164+
165+(defn ctor-site [s]
166+ ;; "X." / "->X" / qualified spellings → the computed-name Def in the file that
167+ ;; mentions the class stem, else the exceptions.go-style loop
168+ (when-let [stem (or (second (re-find #"^->(?:\w+\.)*(\w+)$" s)) (second (re-find #"^(?:\w+\.)*(\w+)\.$" s)))]
169+ (or (first (filter #(str/includes? (:text %) (str "\"" stem)) computed))
170+ (first (filter #(re-find #"\"->\" \+" (:text %)) computed)))))
171+
172+;; ---- runtime truth ----
173+(def native-vals
174+ (into (sorted-map)
175+ (for [n (all-ns) [s v] (ns-publics n)
176+ :let [x (try @v (catch Exception _ nil))]
177+ :when (= "let-go.lang.NativeFn" (str (type x)))]
178+ [(str (ns-name n) "/" s) x])))
179+
180+(defn site-of [q]
181+ ;; strong registrations before weak ones (bare constructor names, descriptor-
182+ ;; only directives), and within each an ns+name match before a name match
183+ (let [[n s] (let [i (str/index-of q "/" 1)] [(subs q 0 i) (subs q (inc i))])
184+ ;; a name-only candidate whose file spells this ns as a literal wins:
185+ ;; installMathNS loops over ["math" "clojure.math"], installMathStatics
186+ ;; over ["Math" "java.lang.Math"], and both Def "pow"
187+ ;; (import lines — a bare `"math"` — do not count)
188+ names-ns? (memoize (fn [path]
189+ (let [lit (str "\"" n "\"")]
190+ (some #(and (str/includes? % lit) (not (re-find #"^\s*(import\s+)?(\w+\s+)?\"[^\"]*\"\s*$" %)))
191+ (file-lines path)))))
192+ best (fn [weak? xs] (first (sort-by (fn [e] [(if (names-ns? (:path e)) 0 1) (rank e)])
193+ (filter #(= weak? (boolean (:weak %))) xs))))]
194+ (or (some (fn [[weak? m]]
195+ (let [xs (if (= m "exact") (by-ns+name [n s]) (by-name s))]
196+ (when-let [e (best weak? xs)]
197+ ;; several directives can register one name (Reduce + Reduce3):
198+ ;; the arity column lists them all
199+ (let [ars (distinct (keep #(when (and (= (:via %) (:via e)) (= (:path %) (:path e))) (:arity %)) xs))
200+ known (remove #{"?"} ars)]
201+ [(assoc e :arity (if (seq known) (str/join "," (sort known)) "?")) m]))))
202+ [[false "exact"] [false "name"] [true "exact"] [true "name"]])
203+ (when-let [c (ctor-site s)] [(assoc c :via "ns.Def" :arity "?") "computed"])
204+ [nil "none"])))
205+
206+(def site-map (into {} (for [q (keys native-vals)] [q (site-of q)])))
207+
208+;; Vars bound to the very same NativeFn object (pr-str carries its address):
209+;; `ref`/`agent` are `atom`, Math/* and java.lang.Math/* share fns. A twin for
210+;; one member covers the group, so each row names its group's canonical member:
211+;; the one with a Go registration, else the first by name.
212+(def same-fn
213+ (into {}
214+ (for [[_ grp] (group-by #(pr-str (native-vals %)) (keys native-vals))
215+ :when (> (count grp) 1)
216+ :let [go? #(re-find #"\.go$" (str (:path (first (site-map %)))))
217+ canon (first (sort-by (fn [q] [(if (go? q) 0 1) q]) grp))]
218+ q grp]
219+ [q canon])))
220+
221+(println (str "# native inventory: lg let-go " full-sha " (commit " commit-date ")"
222+ ", generated " (str/trim (sh-out "date" "+%F")) " by tools/native-inventory.lg"))
223+(println (str "# " (count native-vals) " native vars in " (count (distinct (map #(subs % 0 (str/index-of % "/" 1)) (keys native-vals)))) " namespaces; registered-via "
224+ (str/join ", " (for [[k v] (sort (frequencies (map #(or (:via (first (site-map %))) "other") (keys native-vals))))] (str k "=" v)))
225+ "; match " (str/join ", " (for [[k v] (sort (frequencies (map #(second (site-map %)) (keys native-vals))))] (str k "=" v)))))
226+(println "# var\tarities\tsource\tregistered-via\tmatch\tsame-fn-as")
227+(doseq [q (keys native-vals)]
228+ (let [[site m] (site-map q)]
229+ (println (str/join "\t" [q (if site (:arity site) "?")
230+ (if site (str (:path site) ":" (:line site)) "?")
231+ (if site (:via site) "other")
232+ m
233+ (let [c (same-fn q)] (if (and c (not= c q)) c "-"))]))))
shell

@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
1+#!/usr/bin/env bash
2+# tools/reach.sh <program-root> <ns-prefix> [ns...] — refresh a reach list.
3+#
4+# Thin wrapper over ../emit-wasm-probe/reach.lg (called in place): which Go
5+# natives does a program reach transitively? Roots are every def in the named
6+# namespaces; lg-defined core fns are followed through let-go's sources; Go
7+# natives are the leaves. Prints the sorted `ns/name` list on stdout (the
8+# format checks/native-twins.sh reads) and reach.lg's summary on stderr.
9+#
10+# With no ns arguments, every ns under <program-root> whose file is where
11+# `require` looks for it (<root>/<ns-path>.lg) and whose name starts with
12+# <ns-prefix> is a root. That includes xsofy's tests (xsofy/test/*, ns
13+# xsofy.test.*) and excludes legmacs's (test/*, off the ns path).
14+#
15+# Reproduced the probe's lists (same entries, C-sorted) on 2026-10-01 (lg 4e769212):
16+# tools/reach.sh ~/projects-new/3p/xsofy xsofy > corpus/natives/natives-xsofy.txt # 71 ns
17+# tools/reach.sh ~/projects-new/3p/legmacs legmacs > corpus/natives/natives-legmacs.txt # 29 ns
18+# comm -12 corpus/natives/natives-{xsofy,legmacs}.txt > corpus/natives/natives-shared.txt
19+#
20+# reach.lg resolves relative slurps (test fixtures) against its cwd and spits
21+# reach-natives.txt into it, so it runs in a scratch dir that mirrors the
22+# program root's top level with symlinks: the checkout is never written.
23+#
24+# Env: LG (native lg), LETGO (let-go checkout whose pkg/rt/core sources are
25+# indexed; should be at the SHA the lg was built from).
26+set -euo pipefail
27+here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
28+LG=${LG:-$HOME/projects-new/3p/lg-bin/lg-4e76921230}
29+LETGO=${LETGO:-$HOME/projects-new/3p/let-go}
30+reach_lg=$here/../emit-wasm-probe/reach.lg
31+
32+root=$(cd "${1:?usage: tools/reach.sh <program-root> <ns-prefix> [ns...]}" && pwd)
33+prefix=${2:?ns-prefix required}
34+shift 2
35+
36+lg_sha=$("$LG" -version 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*(\([0-9a-f]\{7,\}\)).*/\1/p' | head -1)
37+if [ -n "$lg_sha" ] && ! git -C "$LETGO" merge-base --is-ancestor "$lg_sha" HEAD 2>/dev/null; then
38+ echo "warning: $LETGO HEAD is not at or after lg's $lg_sha; core sources may not match the binary" >&2
39+fi
40+
41+work=$(mktemp -d)
42+trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
43+for e in "$root"/* "$root"/.[!.]*; do
44+ if [ -e "$e" ]; then ln -s "$e" "$work/${e##*/}"; fi
45+done
46+
47+# ns → file for every .lg under the program root
48+find "$root" -name '*.lg' -not -path '*/.git/*' -not -path '*/worktrees/*' -not -path '*/dist/*' \
49+ | while IFS= read -r f; do
50+ n=$(awk '/^\(ns /{print $2; exit}' "$f")
51+ # only files `require` can find: main.lg's xsofy.main lives at the root,
52+ # not at xsofy/main.lg, so it cannot be a root
53+ rel=$(printf '%s' "$n" | tr '.-' '/_').lg
54+ if [ -n "$n" ] && [ "$f" = "$root/$rel" ]; then printf '%s\t%s\n' "$n" "$f"; fi
55+ done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$work/.ns-map"
56+
57+if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then
58+ awk -F'\t' -v p="$prefix" 'index($1, p) == 1 {print $1}' "$work/.ns-map" > "$work/.nses"
59+else
60+ printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$work/.nses"
61+fi
62+[ -s "$work/.nses" ] || { echo "no namespaces to root at" >&2; exit 2; }
63+
64+{ find "$LETGO/pkg/rt/core" -name '*.lg' | LC_ALL=C sort
65+ awk -F'\t' 'NR==FNR {want[$1]=1; next} ($1 in want) {print $2}' "$work/.nses" "$work/.ns-map"
66+} > "$work/.files"
67+
68+missing=$(awk -F'\t' 'NR==FNR {have[$1]=1; next} !($1 in have)' "$work/.ns-map" "$work/.nses")
69+[ -z "$missing" ] || { echo "no source file for: $missing" >&2; exit 2; }
70+
71+(cd "$work" && xargs "$LG" -source-paths "$root" "$reach_lg" .files "$prefix" < .nses) >&2
72+LC_ALL=C sort "$work/reach-natives.txt"

@@ -0,0 +1,120 @@
1+;; tools/twin-manifest.lg — which let-go natives the wasm runtime claims to
2+;; provide. A runtime defn claims a native by carrying `:twin` metadata on its
3+;; name, the same place D24 keeps `:intrinsic`/`:wasm`:
4+;;
5+;; (defn ^{:twin "core/first"} first [x] …)
6+;; (defn ^{:twin ["core/hash" "core/hash-ordered-coll"]} hash [x] …)
7+;;
8+;; The value is the native's `ns/name` as the inventory and the reach lists
9+;; spell it (runtime ns names: core, string, os, …), or a vector of them.
10+;;
11+;; lg tools/twin-manifest.lg [rt-dir]
12+;; → TSV twin runtime-var file:line (the real manifest)
13+;; lg tools/twin-manifest.lg --propose [rt-dir] [inventory.tsv]
14+;; → TSV twin runtime-var file:line confidence runtime-arities
15+;; native-arities note
16+;; a name-matched proposal for applying the markers (see tools/README.md)
17+;;
18+;; Reads the sources with read-string rather than loading them: the runtime
19+;; files need not load together under native lg for the scan to work, and the
20+;; reader turns `^{…} name` into `(with-meta name {…})`, which is what this
21+;; matches.
22+(require '[clojure.string :as str])
23+
24+(def argv (vec (rest (drop-while #(not (str/ends-with? % "twin-manifest.lg")) os/args))))
25+(def propose? (= "--propose" (first argv)))
26+(def pos-args (if propose? (rest argv) argv))
27+(def rt-dir (or (first pos-args) "rt/wasm"))
28+(def inventory-path (or (second pos-args) "corpus/natives/inventory.tsv"))
29+
30+(defn rt-files []
31+ (sort (for [f (os/ls rt-dir) :when (str/ends-with? f ".lg")] (str rt-dir "/" f))))
32+
33+(defn defn-name+meta [nm]
34+ ;; plain symbol, or the reader's (with-meta sym {…})
35+ (if (and (seq? nm) (= 'with-meta (first nm))) [(second nm) (nth nm 2)] [nm nil]))
36+
37+(defn arities [more]
38+ (let [more (if (string? (first more)) (rest more) more)
39+ more (if (map? (first more)) (rest more) more)
40+ groups (if (vector? (first more)) [(first more)] (map first more))]
41+ (str/join "," (for [ps groups]
42+ (let [n (count (take-while #(not= '& %) ps))]
43+ (if (some #(= '& %) ps) (str ">=" n) (str n)))))))
44+
45+(defn file-defns [path]
46+ (let [text (slurp path)
47+ lines (str/split-lines text)
48+ forms (read-string (str "[" text "\n]"))
49+ ns-sym (some #(when (and (seq? %) (= 'ns (first %))) (second %)) forms)]
50+ (for [f forms
51+ :when (and (seq? f) ('#{defn defn-} (first f)))
52+ :let [[nm m] (defn-name+meta (second f))
53+ ;; first source line whose defn head names this symbol
54+ re (re-pattern (str "^\\(defn-?\\s+(?:\\^\\{.*?\\}\\s+)?" (str/replace (str nm) #"[?!*+.$<>=|]" #(str "\\" %)) "(?:\\s|$|\\[|\\()"))
55+ line (some (fn [i] (when (re-find re (nth lines i)) (inc i))) (range (count lines)))]]
56+ {:ns (str ns-sym) :name (str nm) :private? (or (= 'defn- (first f)) (:private m))
57+ :twin (:twin m) :path path :line (or line 0) :arities (arities (drop 2 f))})))
58+
59+(def defns (mapcat file-defns (rt-files)))
60+
61+(defn claims [d]
62+ (let [t (:twin d)] (cond (nil? t) [] (string? t) [t] :else (vec t))))
63+
64+(if-not propose?
65+ (doseq [d defns, t (claims d)]
66+ (println (str/join "\t" [t (str (:ns d) "/" (:name d)) (str (:path d) ":" (:line d))])))
67+
68+ ;; ---- --propose: name-match the runtime's public defns to the inventory ----
69+ (let [inv (into {} (for [l (str/split-lines (slurp inventory-path))
70+ :when (not (str/starts-with? l "#"))
71+ :let [[q ar] (str/split l #"\t")]]
72+ [q ar]))
73+ ;; Kind-specific entry points whose name differs from the native's:
74+ ;; one collection kind each, so `low` until P2.9's dispatching entry
75+ ;; (D48's per-kind hooks) routes the native to them.
76+ renamed {"wasm.pvec" {"vcount" "core/count" "vnth" "core/nth" "vconj" "core/conj"
77+ "vassoc" "core/assoc" "vpop" "core/pop" "empty-vec" "core/vector"}
78+ "wasm.phm" {"mcount" "core/count" "mget" "core/get" "mcontains?" "core/contains?"
79+ "massoc" "core/assoc" "mdissoc" "core/dissoc" "empty-map" "core/hash-map"
80+ "transient-map" "core/transient" "tassoc!" "core/assoc!"
81+ "tdissoc!" "core/dissoc!" "tget" "core/get" "tcount" "core/count"
82+ "tpersistent!" "core/persistent!" "mequiv" "core/=" "mhash" "core/hash"}
83+ "wasm.phs" {"scount" "core/count" "sconj" "core/conj" "sdisj" "core/disj"
84+ "scontains?" "core/contains?" "sget" "core/get" "sseq" "core/seq"
85+ "empty-set" "core/hash-set" "transient-set" "core/transient"
86+ "tconj!" "core/conj!" "tdisj!" "core/disj!" "tscount" "core/count"
87+ "tpersistent-set!" "core/persistent!" "sequiv" "core/=" "shash" "core/hash"}
88+ ;; same semantics, different spelling
89+ "wasm.seq" {"equals" "core/="}
90+ "wasm.str" {"equals" "core/=" "string-upper-case" "string/upper-case"}}
91+ public (remove :private? (remove #(= "wasm.intrinsics" (:ns %)) defns))
92+ ;; identity matches core/ only: string/trim etc. are the same NativeFn as
93+ ;; core/trim (the inventory's same-fn-as), which the twin report follows
94+ ;; names defined in more than one runtime file: seq.lg's copy is the
95+ ;; claim, str.lg's string-kind copy folds into it at P2.9 (D48)
96+ dup (set (for [[n ds] (group-by :name public) :when (> (count ds) 1)] n))
97+ rows (for [d public
98+ :let [short (str/replace (:ns d) #"^wasm\." "")
99+ ren (get-in renamed [(:ns d) (:name d)])
100+ ident (filter inv [(str "core/" (:name d))])]
101+ [twin conf note]
102+ (concat
103+ (when (and ren (inv ren))
104+ [[ren (if (#{"wasm.seq" "wasm.str"} (:ns d)) "medium" "low")
105+ (if (#{"wasm.seq" "wasm.str"} (:ns d))
106+ "renamed entry; check arity coverage"
107+ (str short "-kind half only; needs the P2.9 dispatching entry"))]])
108+ (when-not ren
109+ (for [q ident]
110+ (cond
111+ (and (dup (:name d)) (not= "wasm.seq" (:ns d)))
112+ [q "low" (str "string-kind copy; seq.lg's " (:name d) " is the claim after D48")]
113+ (dup (:name d))
114+ [q "medium" "string-kind half lives in str.lg until P2.9 folds it in (D48)"]
115+ :else
116+ [q "high" "same name"]))))]
117+ [twin (str (:ns d) "/" (:name d)) (str (:path d) ":" (:line d)) conf (:arities d) (inv twin) note])]
118+ (println "# twin\truntime-var\tfile:line\tconfidence\truntime-arities\tnative-arities\tnote")
119+ (doseq [r (sort-by (juxt first second) rows)]
120+ (println (str/join "\t" r)))))
